parameters.help_en: The business phone number. You can call the ListChatGroup (https://api.aliyun.com/document/cams/2020-06-06/ListChatGroup) operation to query the business phone number

WHATSAPP

parameters.help_en: The space ID or instance ID of the ISV sub-customer, which is the channel ID. You can view the channel ID on the Channels Management (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement) page

parameters.help_en:
The group profile picture.

Image limits:
Supported MIME type: image/jpeg.
Maximum image size: 5 MB.
The image must be square, with a minimum width and height of 192 × 192 pixels
parameters.help_zh:
群组头像。

图片限制
仅支持的mime type：image/jpeg
图片大小最大：5MB
图片必须是正方形，最小宽高：192 x 192
